body:
**Starts** once #52 and #56 are merged.

## Why

Until now, the user sees the plan only in the coordinator's chat replies. The itinerary view shows the whole plan beside the chat, and keeps it up to date after each turn (functional spec 9).

## Design

- [Functional spec](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/functional-spec.md), sections 7.6 and 9.1 to 9.7.

## Open questions

- None.

## Do

- Add an endpoint that returns the itinerary for the browser, including route lines for the map.
- Show the itinerary beside the chat: the trip summary, stays, legs, and each day's schedule with its free time and rest days. Selected places show their rationale. Refresh the view after each turn.

## Done when

- On the deployed site (systems design, section 7), the San Francisco skeleton and Day 1 show as in domain model section 5.1.

## Ends in

A PR.

**Settled in:** chat. Propose each answer to Joe in chat first, and write it in once he agrees.

---

Moved from the [development plan](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/plan/development-plan.md#phase-24-the-itinerary-view).
